cards.title: Our Vision
cards.desc: Our vision is to create a place where you can buy the latest and best mobile phones and accessories with better best customer care services, all for a great price.

cards.title: What We Do
cards.desc: We provide the latest mobile phones and accessories to our customers with great service and support for their tech products all around Sri Lanka.

cards.title: Company History
cards.desc: GQ mobiles Pvt Ltd was founded in 2002. We have now expanded our operations into main branch at Liberty Plaza to better serve our loyal customers.

services.title: Online Ordering. Your phone delivered to your doorstep!
services.body: Prefer to purchase online? Then visit our online store. You can search by Brand, budget, or even model name. Once you've decided just complete the payment details. We promise to deliver your phone within 07 working days straight to your doorstep. We even give a cashback guarantee if you're not satisfied.

services.title: After Sales support. Fast response and solutions that satisfy.
services.body: Nothing more frustrating than when a phone starts playing up. We understand! That's why we aim to provide you fast and reliable after-sales support. For any support just call us on +94 75 455 5665
